CREATE TABLE advisor_approval_transitions(
      sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      transition_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      recommendation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      from_status TEXT,
      to_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(to_status IN
        ('pending','approved','rejected','manual_applied','rolled_back')),
      actor TEXT NOT NULL,
      reason TEXT NOT NULL,
      occurred_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
      config_hash_before TEXT,
      config_hash_after TEXT,
      rollback_reference TEXT,
      previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      transition_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      FOREIGN KEY(recommendation_id)
        REFERENCES advisor_recommendation_ledger(recommendation_id)
    )
triggers:
CREATE TRIGGER advisor_transitions_no_delete
       BEFORE DELETE ON advisor_approval_transitions
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'approval transitions are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER advisor_transitions_no_update
       BEFORE UPDATE ON advisor_approval_transitions
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'approval transitions are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE advisor_recommendation_ledger(
      recommendation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      advisor_version TEXT NOT NULL,
      evidence_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL,
      parameter TEXT NOT NULL,
      old_value_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      new_value_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      reason_code TEXT NOT NULL,
      reason TEXT NOT NULL,
      risk_level TEXT NOT NULL,
      applies_to_mode TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN
        ('pending','approved','rejected','manual_applied','rolled_back')),
      payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_artifact TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_artifact_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      imported_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
      approved_by TEXT,
      approved_at_ms INTEGER,
      applied_by TEXT,
      applied_at_ms INTEGER,
      config_hash_before TEXT,
      config_hash_after TEXT,
      rollback_reference TEXT,
      rolled_back_by TEXT,
      rolled_back_at_ms INTEGER,
      superseded_by TEXT,
      superseded_at_ms INTEGER
    )

CREATE TABLE ai_recommendations(
   event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, mode TEXT NOT NULL,
   is_exchange_verified INTEGER NOT NULL,"recommendation_id" TEXT,"status" TEXT,"parameter" TEXT,"current" TEXT,"recommended" TEXT,"reason" TEXT,
   FOREIGN KEY(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified)
   REFERENCES events(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE attempts(
              correlation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
              mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('paper','real','test','replay')),
              UNIQUE(correlation_id,mode)
            )

CREATE TABLE collector_runs(
              run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, started_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
              updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, closed_cleanly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
              stats_json TEXT NOT NULL
            )

CREATE TABLE daily_reports(
   event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, mode TEXT NOT NULL,
   is_exchange_verified INTEGER NOT NULL,"date" TEXT,"report_id" TEXT,
   FOREIGN KEY(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified)
   REFERENCES events(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE decisions(
   event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, mode TEXT NOT NULL,
   is_exchange_verified INTEGER NOT NULL,"decision" TEXT,"skip_reason" TEXT,"original_reason" TEXT,
   FOREIGN KEY(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified)
   REFERENCES events(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE entries(
   event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, mode TEXT NOT NULL,
   is_exchange_verified INTEGER NOT NULL,"entry_id" TEXT,"planned_usdt" TEXT,"planned_amount" TEXT,"entry_spread_bps" TEXT,"spot_entry_mode" TEXT,"fut_entry_mode" TEXT,"spot_order_id" TEXT,"fut_order_id" TEXT,"spot_expected_price" TEXT,"spot_actual_price" TEXT,"fut_expected_price" TEXT,"fut_actual_price" TEXT,"spot_fill_ratio" TEXT,"fut_fill_ratio" TEXT,"entry_slippage_bps" TEXT,"fees_entry_usdt" TEXT,"entry_status" TEXT,
   FOREIGN KEY(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified)
   REFERENCES events(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE errors(
   event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, mode TEXT NOT NULL,
   is_exchange_verified INTEGER NOT NULL,"module" TEXT,"function" TEXT,"exchange" TEXT,"error_type" TEXT,"error_text" TEXT,"traceback" TEXT,"severity" TEXT,"resolved" TEXT,
   FOREIGN KEY(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified)
   REFERENCES events(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE events(
              event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(schema_version=1),
              mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('paper','real','test','replay')),
              category TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
              occurred_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, received_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
              correlation_id TEXT, signal_id TEXT, base TEXT, shadow_group_id TEXT,
              comparison_id TEXT, reason_code TEXT,
              verification_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified'
                CHECK(verification_status IN ('unknown','unverified','observed','partially_verified','verified','contradicted')),
              is_exchange_verified INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_exchange_verified IN (0,1)),
              payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, verification_json TEXT NOT NULL,
              content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
              CHECK(mode='real' OR is_exchange_verified=0),
              UNIQUE(event_id,mode,is_exchange_verified),
              FOREIGN KEY(correlation_id,mode) REFERENCES attempts(correlation_id,mode)
            )

              WHERE category='entries' AND name='ENTRY_COMMIT'
